parts.name: Input
parts.description: Unlabelled native input. Use with FormLabel/FormControl or an accessible name. size controls visual dimensions; htmlSize is the native character-width hint.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size: small, medium or large.

props.name: htmlSize
props.description: Native input size attribute, measured as an approximate character width; does not select the visual component size.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type; the browser defaults to text.

props.name: value
props.description: Current native control value. Pair with onChange for controlled input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value used when the native control is uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native input change handler. Read value or checked from event.currentTarget.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a non-empty native control value during form validation.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps the current value readable and focusable while preventing editing.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when the control has no value.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum input length enforced by the browser.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not already name the element.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the native control invalid for assistive technology.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of additional descriptive elements; field components merge these with their hint or error ID.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
